notes: SPEC A8 — LLM-judgment layer for memo-writer (routing + behavior). Run by the chalette-side Gate 15 executor/grader; run_all.py ignores this file (the aggregator only lints its shape).

prompts.name: route_decision_memo
prompts.input: write a memo on our pricing decision
assert: Fires memo-writer, not decision-log or decision-memo-composer

prompts.name: route_strategy_memo
prompts.input: draft a strategy memo on vendor selection

prompts.name: negative_log_decision
assert: Does NOT fire memo-writer — routes to decision-log (capture, not a memo)

prompts.name: negative_decide_between
prompts.input: help me decide between annual and monthly pricing
assert: Does NOT fire memo-writer — routes to decision-memo-composer (forward-looking tradeoff)

prompts.name: behavior_thesis_first
prompts.input: write a decision memo on pricing
assert: Thesis/decision appears in the first two sentences (decision-forward)

prompts.name: behavior_no_tells
prompts.input: write a strategy memo on the rollout
assert: No banned phrases (leverage, synergy, stakeholder, Phase N)

prompts.name: behavior_docx_and_event
assert: Logs a memo_drafted event with source_decision_ids
